context: A uni student debates a teacher on international affairs
purpose: Teach: 領土/仲裁/参画/黒字/税率/閣僚/総長/奉仕

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、最近のニュース見ました？例の領土問題、また閣僚会議で揉めてるみたいですね。
lines.en: Teacher, did you see the recent news? The territorial dispute is causing trouble at the cabinet meeting again.
lines.style: Casual but respectful student tone, slightly provocative opening.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、見ましたよ。でも今回は国際仲裁に持ち込むべきだという声も大きいでしょう。
lines.en: Yes, I saw it. But this time there are loud voices saying it should be taken to international arbitration.
lines.style: Calm teacher tone, measured and analytical delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 正直、仲裁役なんて時間の無駄だと思うんですよ。結局、大国が決めるじゃないですか。
lines.en: Honestly, I think an arbitrator role is just a waste of time. In the end, the great powers decide everything anyway.
lines.style: Confident, slightly cynical young man pushing back.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう決めつけるのは早いわ。市民が政策参画する仕組みが整えば、外交だって変わるはずよ。
lines.en: It's too early to conclude that. If we build systems for citizen participation in policy, even diplomacy will change.
lines.style: Firm corrective tone, gently lecturing the student further.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも現実は厳しいですよ。貿易黒字を維持するために、消費税率まで上げて、国民は疲弊してます。
lines.en: But reality is harsh. To maintain the trade surplus, they even raised the consumption tax rate, and citizens are exhausted.
lines.style: Frustrated, passionate argumentative student voice rising.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それは確かに問題ね。だからこそ、国連の事務総長レベルでの対話が必要なんじゃないかしら。
lines.en: That is certainly a problem. That's exactly why dialogue at the UN Secretary-General level is necessary, isn't it?
lines.style: Thoughtful, redirecting conversation with rhetorical question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 理想論ですよ、先生。政治家にボランティア奉仕の精神なんて期待できますか？
lines.en: That's idealism, teacher. Can we really expect politicians to have the spirit of volunteer service?
lines.style: Sharp challenge, leaning forward with skeptical edge.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮くん、皮肉も大事だけど、諦めたらそこで終わりよ。私はまだ希望を持ってるわ。
lines.en: Ren, sarcasm is important too, but if you give up, that's the end. I still hold onto hope.
lines.style: Warm but serious closing, motherly mentor delivery.
